purpose: Teach: エコロジー/ダーウィン/コンドーム/左脳/王宮/地球人/父兄/中尉

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、エコロジーに配慮した医療廃棄物処理を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we're implementing environmentally conscious medical waste disposal as a team.
lines.style: Steady, clear delivery. No condescension. Matter-of-fact opening, like explaining standard protocol. Voice warm and level throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ダーウィン理論の医学的応用を医療チームで議論します
lines.en: Yes — we'll be discussing the medical applications of evolutionary theory with the team.
lines.style: Patient, measured pace. Slight weight on 'theory' as if inviting intellectual engagement. Warm underlying tone without softening the idea.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、コンドーム配布によるSTD予防を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Ren, we're moving forward with STD prevention through condom distribution as a team initiative.
lines.style: Direct and calm. Clinical precision without coldness. Treats the topic as important healthcare work, not awkward. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 左脳血流量を、貴院、画像で評価されますね、先生
lines.en: At your hospital, you assess left-brain blood flow with imaging, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine intellectual curiosity. Quiet and thoughtful. Slightly hesitant — testing the waters, wanting confirmation. Respectful distance in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、王宮医の伝統を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Yes — we're studying the traditions of royal physicians as a team.
lines.style: Patient acceptance of the topic. Light on 'traditions' as if this is one piece among many. Steady, unbothered tone. Matter-of-fact in delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、地球人の長寿の秘訣を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes — we're researching the secrets of longevity among people around the world as a team.
lines.style: Patient, engaged. Slight warmth on 'longevity' — this matters to people. Clear and direct without rushing. Open curiosity in the pacing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、父兄向け医療相談会を医療チームで企画します
lines.en: Yes — we're planning a medical consultation event for parents and families with the team.
lines.style: Organized and clear. Slightly warmer than clinical — acknowledges the human dimension. Steady, purposeful delivery without hurry. Professional kindness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 元中尉の方を、貴院、健診で受けられますね、先生
lines.en: Former lieutenants — they can receive health screenings at your hospital, can't they, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle, observant question. Quiet and careful phrasing. Slight pause before 'health screenings' as if thinking through the words. Respectful, seeking understanding.
